style: Warm softly lit cartoon matching this object exact approved native world model; accepted Indigo noren and warm ceramic UI family. Preserve existing native3/4 merchandise capture and goods card layout.

authority.interpretation: Approved native world geometry and rendering response are exact authority. The old goods image supplies the pinned camera, while the fixed world target supplies aesthetic context. No new ImageGen target is needed.

visibleOutcomes.shapeVolume: The view visibly exposes the plant's top/front/right forms as a real orthographic three-quarter object. Broad thick folded leaves, pointed tips, coherent crown attachment, tapered square pot and rounded continuous rim retain the approved model's identity. Do not flatten, mirror or card the world sprite, copy the old thin-sheet foliage, or require an invented unseen target silhouette.
visibleOutcomes.colorMaterialDetail: The unchanged approved materials read as fresh lime fold planes, rich green turning faces, a warm golden rim, terracotta body and recessed warm brown soil. Preserve simple broad surfaces, softly treated edges and sparse detail. Do not demand target-exact paint colors or introduce texture/noise/gloss beyond the approved source.
visibleOutcomes.lightingHighlights: The exact approved native world/light/material/render response produces broad soft volume and clean highlights in the new camera. No unexplained black pot-corner wedge, dead side face, blown highlight, sharp plastic streak, added shadow receiver or view-specific grade is acceptable. Natural cavity/crown occlusion is acceptable when the forms remain readable.
visibleOutcomes.artifactFreeReadability: At native 384x384 and logical 66x66 and 96x96 display canvases, inspect the full original canvas uniformly scaled on light cream, midgray and dark backgrounds. Preserve a recognizable leaf fan, crown, rim opening and pot volume without clipping, intrusive black corners, leaf intersections, floating pieces, coplanar artifacts, halos or contaminated alpha. Do not crop or resize each image independently to improve apparent fit.
visibleOutcomes.consumerCoherence: In actual full-screen Godot goods-card captures, the plant reads as the approved refined world object within the existing cream/indigo UI family. Its canvas keeps the consumer's unchanged aspect-preserving fit and card layout. Dynamic labels, stock counts, badges and controls remain legible, unchanged and separate from artwork. A mocked-up or cropped card is useful supplementary evidence but cannot replace the actual consumer.

hardConstraints.sourceParity: Candidate saved native scene must retain exact approved mesh geometry/topology, mesh and object transforms, modifiers, leaf shape-key data, complete action key/slot/curve data, rootS0, material assignments/nodes/values, light data/transforms, world nodes/values, compositor and display/render response. Compare source and candidate under identical existing-static-action normalization, including evaluated meshes, before save and after independent reopen. Do not compare a normalized candidate against the source's accidentally saved idle pose. No modeling or appearance change is authorized; the only exceptions are existing static action selection/frame normalization and the declared camera/output geometry settings.

staticPoseNormalization.matchingSlots: KEplant-angular__leaf_00__shape_keys through KEplant-angular__leaf_11__shape_keys, each bound to its corresponding original leaf Key owner
staticPoseNormalization.authority: The original approved native static action data, selected at frame 1 in both approved source and candidate, is the visual/evaluated source baseline. Selecting these existing actions is allowed. Editing their keyframes, shape data, rig or base geometry is not normalization.

camera.exception: Use the complete pinned old goods camera matrix, projection, target/position and ortho scale plus the required square render canvas/pixels. Do not per-image fit, recenter, orbit, distort or otherwise tune the camera to hide defects.

hardConstraints.output: Actual native 384x384 RGBA PNG with preserved native alpha and transparent margins. No raster paint, image warp, target card, crop fitting, recolor, second grade or export-only cleanup. Runtime atlas must preserve all native pixels and alpha with the existing transparent gutters and sampling contract.
hardConstraints.sourceSafety: Preserve approved world source bytes, registered world sprites, production renderer, UI code/layout and floor. Keep the supplement editable with complete packed or hash-bound dependency closure; no missing external resource or unbound linked source.
hardConstraints.consumer: Use the unchanged ItemPreview goods consumer, category/page/control logic, current captions/counts, stock styling and floor presentation. Layout page size remains 4. The initial layout inventory is belt 6, stool 4, plant 2, crate 2, barrel 1; dynamic scenario changes must exactly match recorded state. Floor-cream icon keeps its accepted exact bytes. Other goods and UI remain byte-identical to the coordinator's explicitly pinned comparison baseline, except separately approved sibling supplements integrated by the coordinator.

requiredEvidence.immutablePacket: Hash-bound supplement brief, frozen criteria, fixed references, approved source identity, native candidate project, raw native goods PNG, previews and technical validation. Review binds the exact packet SHA-256 and inspected file paths.
requiredEvidence.savedReopenedParity: Native inspection must compare canonical source state with the saved and separately reopened candidate. Normalize approved source and candidate to the same explicitly named 12 static actions, matching original Key slots, frame 1/rootS0 and zero Breeze values before evaluated comparisons. Include base geometry/topology/transforms/modifiers/rest-shape/evaluated-mesh parity, complete unchanged actions/rig data, material/light/world/compositor/render-response parity and exact camera exception checks. Source manifest claims alone are insufficient.
requiredEvidence.nativeRecapture: Independently reopen the exact candidate .blend and recapture it natively; bind the recapture and compare it to candidate pixels. Confirm dimensions, camera matrix/projection/ortho/pixel aspect, transparency, dependency closure, source preservation and no post-render treatment.
requiredEvidence.visual: Inspect full native goods PNG, approved world render/model and prior goods render, 66px/96px three-background sheets and supplied context-card preview. Inspect every supplied required native preview without relying on editor self-ratings.
requiredEvidence.actualConsumer: Require actual complete Godot phone and landscape or portrait-contained wide captures with native plant goods in the unchanged consumer: first Layout page, following Layout page, relevant selected/disabled stock state and Floor state. Include state snapshots tying visible names/counts to exact inventory, measured preview/card bounds, unchanged floor icon and othergoods/UI hash checks, and lossless atlas-to-native render checks. Reuse coordinator-wide consumer captures when they are bound to the exact approved plant pixels; do not require a UI redesign or touch unrelated assets.

qualityCriteria.conflictAndApprovalRule: If exact approved source under the immutable camera has a substantive new-view defect, return revise with the source-defect conflict and request a proper world revision through the coordinator. Do not lower this bar, alter the world model in the supplement or accept a hidden defect. Missing source/native/consumer evidence is needs_evidence, never approval. Approval is specific to the exact supplement and does not approve world changes or deployment.
